title: hedera iberica
intro: Hedera iberica, commonly known as the Spanish ivy or Canary Island ivy, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hedera iberica include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions like arthritis and neurodegenerative diseases. The bioactive constituents of Hedera iberica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
